name: Sarkoth
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua waits for help after Sarkoth's venom leaves him stranded. You have slain the scorpid that wounded him; now Gornek needs word at the Den so aid can reach the scout.

sections.title: A Scout's Plight
sections.body: Hana'zua, a Darkspear scout, lies stranded on the high bluffs of the Valley of Trials. Sarkoth's venom has left him too weak to descend the treacherous paths alone. You have avenged him by slaying the scorpid, but he still cannot cross the arid stones without help. A passing initiate must carry word down to the training encampment.

sections.title: Honor in the Den
sections.body: Gornek waits at the Den for your report. Once he hears of Hana'zua's plight, he recognizes the danger from Sarkoth and organizes aid for the scout. Horde commanders honor those who set aside their own training to defend and rescue a fallen stranger. Such conduct proves an initiate's worth before they march into Durotar proper.

faq.q: Who is Hana'zua and why is he stranded?
faq.answer: Hana'zua is a young Darkspear troll scout stranded in the high reaches of the Valley of Trials. Sarkoth ambushed and poisoned him, leaving him too weak to climb down alone.
Gornek is an orc overseer at the Den in the Valley of Trials. He evaluates new recruits, assigns survival tasks, and coordinates aid when initiates face deadly threats in the ravine.

aliases: what kind of monster is sarkoth
faq.answer: Sarkoth prowls the rocky bluffs above the Valley of Trials as a notorious, overgrown scorpid. Its venom and ferocity make it a legendary danger to young orcs and trolls in the trials.
Gornek promises to send aid to Hana'zua as soon as he hears your report. What becomes of the scout afterward is not told.

faq.q: Why does Gornek praise this deed so highly?
faq.answer: Surviving the trials is expected. Setting aside your own tasks to defend a stranger's honor and help them survive reflects the values the new Horde seeks to forge in its warriors.
The Den is the central training cave and staging ground at the heart of the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar.

angles.text: As an orc, you know personal strength matters. Defending an incapacitated ally's honor shows the heart of a true warrior.
As a troll, you can strengthen the young bond between the Darkspear tribe and Thrall's orcs by saving Hana'zua from a slow death by venom.
As a member of the Horde, you learn that survival in a harsh, unforgiving land depends on mutual aid. Leaving no comrade behind is taught from an initiate's first steps.
